_comment: Where the price services the app asks for token prices live: each one's api base url, with its version where the url carries one, and no trailing slash. Every request to a service is built on its baseUrl, so a service that moves its api is changed here only. Which of a chain's tokens a service can price is set per chain in chains.json → priceServices. Read by src/lib/price-service-urls.js, which stops startup on a value that is not an https url, naming it.

geckoTerminal._topPoolsConsidered_comment: For a bare token's historical price, GeckoTerminal is asked for the token's pools and the best of its top-ranked ones is read. This is how many are considered: deep enough that a token with several thin pairs reaches a real one, shallow enough that the list stays the service's view of the token's main market. Read by src/lib/gecko-pool-cache.js, which stops startup on a value outside its range in setting-bounds.json.
